stage.name: Decaying Wastes
stage.description:
The armies of the Nachzehrer ravage the fields, turning fertile farmland to barren wastes. Send a squad to repel them, and give a sliver of hope to the people of Londinium, who have suffered for too long.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Twigs That Crave> Produces Rot Eaters when destroyed or at the end of the stage.

sarkaz_witherer.name: Sarkaz Witherer
sarkaz_witherer.flavourText: Part of the Nachzehrer army. Death cannot stop their corrupting presence, as their corpses continue to corrupt the land.
abilities: Releases Corruption when defeated, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP

sarkaz_wither_caster.name: Sarkaz Wither Caster
sarkaz_wither_caster.flavourText: Part of the Nachzehrer army. They are able to heal their kin as they attack the enemy. Life is a constant cycle of devouring and sharing.
abilities: Continuously heals the Twigs That Crave

seed_of_withering.name: Seed of Withering
seed_of_withering.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. Mindless except for an obsession with self-destruction. They create death for others to feed upon.
abilities: Self-destructs when near an Operator, dealing Physical damage

sarkaz_swordsman.name: Sarkaz Swordsman
sarkaz_swordsman.flavourText: A Sarkaz mercenary. Though scarred by years of war, they are still fighting to fulfill the orders of their employers.

sarkaz_witherer_captain.name: Sarkaz Witherer Captain
sarkaz_witherer_captain.flavourText: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Death simply causes them to spread their corruption even faster, leaving behind a wasteland where few could survive.
abilities: Releases Corruption when defeated, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP

sarkaz_wither_caster_captain.name: Sarkaz Wither Caster Captain
sarkaz_wither_caster_captain.flavourText: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Experts at healing their kin as they attack the enemy. Life is a constant cycle of devouring and sharing.
abilities: Continuously heals the Twigs That Crave

steam_tank.name: Steam Tank
steam_tank.flavourText: Armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage.
abilities: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

rotchaser.name: Rotchaser
rotchaser.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. Fast-moving, they do not understand the concept of healing. They exist only to create death, and the power of healing robs them of their powers.
abilities: Attacks cause the target to take Arts damage over time; effect removed when the target is healed

scorching_steam_tank.name: Scorching Steam Tank
scorching_steam_tank.flavourText: Advanced armored vehicle employing Victorian steam technology, even more dangerous when it has taken damage. Virtually unstoppable when it is on a rampage.
abilities: When HP drops to 50%, ASPD and Movement Speed are greatly increased, and becomes immune to most control effects.

withering_collector_disciple.name: Withering Collector Disciple
withering_collector_disciple.flavourText: An organic construct containing the Nachzehrer King's Originium Arts. It can extract all kinds of dead souls from the battlefield to create Seeds of Withering.

rampaging_rotchaser.name: Rampaging Rotchaser
rampaging_rotchaser.flavourText: Originium Arts creation of the Nachzehrer King. They do not understand the concept of healing, even if they are stopped. They exist only to create death. Thoughts are incompatible with death, and they never stop.
abilities: Attacks cause the target to take Arts damage over time; effect removed when the target is healed

sarkaz_wither_devourer.name: Sarkaz Wither Devourer
sarkaz_wither_devourer.flavourText: Part of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced

sarkaz_wither_maw.name: Sarkaz Wither Maw
sarkaz_wither_maw.flavourText: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Devours any obstacle in its way, including the living. Anything and everything is food to it. Only death can make it surrender what it devoured.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker. DEF is greatly increased, but Movement Speed is reduced

rot_eater.name: Rot Eater
rot_eater.flavourText: Part of the Nachzehrer army. The longer they remain on the battlefield, the harder they are to defeat, absorbing the enemy's strength as they grow increasingly deadly.
abilities: The more enemies defeated, the higher its HP, ATK, and DEF when spawned from the Twigs That Crave
Releases Corruption, causing your nearby units to continuously lose HP
